item.title: ‘Exteriors’ By Annie Ernaux: An Archive Of The Transient Intersections Of Public Memory
item.description: In 'Exteriors', Ernaux has recorded the otherwise invisible ordinary lives navigating through systemic labour and class hierarchies in the public space. The post ‘Exteriors’ By Annie Ernaux: An Archive Of The Transient Intersections Of Public Memory appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.title: Progressive Mask, Regressive Portrayal: Why ‘Hot Spot 2 Much’ Is Pure Ragebait
item.description: Masquerading as social commentary, Vignesh Karthik’s sequel masks its misogyny, male gaze, and moral policing of women's clothing choices as a meta-critique of society. The post Progressive Mask, Regressive Portrayal: Why ‘Hot Spot 2 Much’ Is Pure Ragebait appeared first on Feminism in India.

item.description: 'Mardaani 3' directed by Abhiraj Minawala and produced by YRF, is a competent, occasionally unsettling, but ultimately cautious film. The post ‘Mardaani 3’ And The Limits Of The “Strong Female Cop” Narrative appeared first on Feminism in India.
